blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said the Land Transportation Office (LTO) must prove the public wrong by sustaining reforms, following transport group Manibela’s warning that corruption could return to the agency after a leadership shakeup. The concerns were raised after LTO chief Markus Lacanilao was transferred to the Maritime Industry Authority (Marina), where he will serve as administrator. Former Naga City Administrator Noreen San Luis, meanwhile, was appointed as the new LTO chief.
